{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove the 6 QA rows with '999,999.99'
# First, identify them by the comma pattern
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
qa_rows = sales[has_commas]

# Filter out these rows
sales_clean = sales[~has_commas]

# Now convert revenue to float
sales_clean['revenue'] = sales_clean['revenue'].astype(float)

# Check the shape to confirm
print(f'Rows after removing QA rows: {len(sales_clean)}')

# Now filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales_clean[
    (sales_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (sales_clean['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Calculate mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

print(f'Mean revenue for loyal customers in completed orders: {mean_revenue}')"}
